gloss: mixed hot pot; assorted ingredients cooked in broth

definitions.gloss: mixed hot pot; assorted ingredients cooked in broth
definitions.explanation: A hot pot dish where various ingredients such as seafood, meat, tofu, and vegetables are simmered together in broth.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}にしよう。
examples.english: Let's have mixed hot pot tonight.

examples.japanese: {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}に{好|す}きな{具材|ぐざい}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put my favorite ingredients in the hot pot.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}はみんなで{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}を{囲|かこ}むのが{一番|いちばん}だ。
examples.english: On cold days, there's nothing better than gathering around a mixed hot pot together.

notes:
A type of {鍋|なべ}{料理|りょうり} (hot pot dish) where various ingredients — typically seafood, meat, tofu, and vegetables — are simmered together in a dashi-based broth. The name comes from {寄|よ}せる (to bring together), reflecting the mix of assorted ingredients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}を{作|つく}る: to make mixed hot pot
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}の{具材|ぐざい}: hot pot ingredients
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}セット: hot pot ingredient set (sold at supermarkets)

CULTURAL NOTE:
A quintessential winter dish in Japan. Unlike specialized hot pots like すき{焼|や}き or しゃぶしゃぶ, {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ} has no fixed recipe — families use whatever ingredients they like. It is commonly eaten as a communal meal, with everyone sharing from the same pot.

RELATED WORDS:
- {鍋|なべ}{料理|りょうり}: hot pot cooking
- すき{焼|や}き: sukiyaki
- しゃぶしゃぶ: shabu-shabu
- {闇鍋|やみなべ}: surprise hot pot (everyone secretly adds an ingredient)
